fields.summary_ko.0: Lam Research, Marvell Technology, onsemi, Seagate, Western Digital and other semiconductor and hardware stocks rebounded strongly on Monday as concerns over AI data center construction eased, with S&P 500 tech sector rising 2%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite Seagate's 14.8% plunge on interest rate hike concerns and Democratic calls to restrict AI data center development, it trades at $510.73, down 53.3% from its 52-week high of $1,094, despite a 77.6% annual gain.
